# DiaryNote v0.1.4-beta.1 (Pre-Release)

Pre-release notes for DiaryNote v0.1.4-beta.1 introducing AI Note Merging, Multilingual LLM Support, and AI Auto-Tagging capabilities.

### AI Note Merging & Background Processing
- **Asynchronous Execution**: Perform AI note merging in the background with real-time start and completion notifications.
- **Selection Persistence & Polish**: Enhanced UI for selection retention, optimized dialog dimensions, and activity tracking.

### Multilingual & Auto-Tagging Features
- **Multilingual Support**: Enhanced prompt matching for English, Bengali, and Banglish language inputs.
- **AI Auto-Tag Command**: Inline automated tagging for quick organization of notes.
- **Popup & UI Polish**: Cursor position utilities for context popovers and calendar entry UI improvements.
